## Description

Parameterizes drift and diffusion coefficients of stochastic volatility SDEs using neural networks trained via neural stochastic differential equation solvers to price and trade volatility spreads.

## Where it may fit

Complex option pricing surfaces, volatility smile dislocation trading.

## Vehicles

Volatility arbitrage desks, options market makers.

## Required data

Intraday option chain quotes, implied volatility surfaces, underlying spot prices.

## Caveats

Requires specialized GPU solvers for neural SDE path simulation and adjoint sensitivity analysis.
